assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit: the canonical V2 reconstruction model MHA_SP2_BAKUGO_KATSUKI_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md (read in full, with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its BK-SUP-01 to BK-SUP-03 sections admit), and the Bakugo Katsuki sections of the Class 1-A character-state ledger, the relationship-state ledger, the Japanese vocabulary ledger and the character-model readiness index, each read for every Bakugo entry together with its front matter and current admissibility corrections. All five are repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42. The readiness index's specialist_ready label and the model's retrospective probe are inputs, not conclusions. The deep readings the model links, the supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit, the source-reverification audit, other characters' models (including Midoriya's, All Might's and Shoto's) and any anime or V1 material are not curated on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Bakugo Katsuki from the V01:p14-24 school hierarchy and V01:p43-68 sludge rescue, through the V02:p032-084 combat trial, V03-V05 Sports Festival and tournament, V06 Jeanist placement, V07:p130-190 exam impasse and V08:p047-068 first cooperation, V09-V11 capture, refusal and extraction, V12-V14 license failure, guilt confession, All Might's correction and secret-holding, V18:p113-166 remedial course, V19-V20 band, V22-V23 Match 4 and licensed incident, V25-V26 naming and Endeavor internship, V28-V30 accompaniment, self-accountability, interception and hero name, V31 recovery, V32-V34 re-entry and apology, V36:p121-197 distributed attack and cardiac collapse, V37 active repair, V40:p084-192 return, gratitude and handoff, to V42:p027-035 rehabilitation and grief and p140-175 armor funding and adult peer work, with BK-SUP-01 to BK-SUP-03 editorial, profile and author-comment facts as endpoints. Kept as separable states: early U.A., training and Kamino, cooperative student, apology and final war, and V42 recovery and adulthood; later understanding is not moved earlier. No class-ledger Bakugo entry covers V15-V17, V21, V24, V27, V35, V38-V39 or V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a durable goal (a heroic victory that deserves his own recognition, not praise alone; V05:p169-175, 世間が認めても俺が認めてなきゃゴミなんだよ, with All Might's 不変の絶対評価 gloss in the vocabulary ledger), an early feared self (being the weak person Midoriya pities; BK01, V01:p60-68, V07:p185) and a post-Kamino feared self (the person who ended All Might; V13:p180-182). Repeated decision rules are located: status threat from Midoriya distorts attention while competence evidence penetrates pride (BK01, V05:p031); cooperation can precede warmth (BK02, V08:p059-062); help is usable inside an equality-compatible relation (V11:p024-025, p176-177); victory comes to include extracting allies (V22:p095-111, V26:p011-012, V36:p121-133). Not A: the one formal probe (BK-V01) is a retrospective, nonblind holdout on one captivity decision with emotional trajectory partial, and the model itself warns against generalizing it. Not C: goals, feared selves and conditional policies are explicit, state-separated and repeated across V01-V42.

The model gives five governed snapshots with forbidden back-projections (early U.A. V01-V05; training and Kamino V07-V14; cooperative student V22-V29; apology and final war V33-V41; V42 recovery and adulthood), and the class ledger carries dated deltas for V01-V14, V18-V20, V22-V23, V25-V26, V28-V34, V36-V37, V40 and V42, with the readiness index tracing moderate -> strong at V10 and strong -> specialist_ready at V29. Transitions are located: guilt correction and secret-holding (V14:p041-049), self-accountability (V29:p156), apology (V33:p070-073), cardiac arrest and active repair (V36:p195, V37:p005-047), received survival (V40:p084-120) and adult limits (V42:p027-028). Not A: ten volumes lack a class-ledger entry, the adult interval is undated, and the exact medical course after V42 is OPEN. Not C: the state changes are located, ordered and enforced by the model's back-projection rules.

The vocabulary ledger, the relationship ledger and the deltas locate 俺-centered informal speech, compressed imperatives and insults (行けデク!! / 役に立てクソカス!! V08:p059-062), the value refusal (俺は オールマイトが 勝つ姿に 憧れた V10:p104; したくねーモンは嘘でもしねんだよ俺ァ V10:p113), private guilt (俺は……オールマイトを 終わらせちまってんだ V13:p180), diagnosis (自分を勘定に入れてねェ V29:p156; 一人で…勝とうと…してんじゃねェっ V30:p008), apology (今まで ごめん V33:p070-073), the address shift from デク to 出久 (V36:p189, V40:p192), gratitude to Edgeshot (生かしてくれてありがとう先輩, relationship ledger, V40), plural counterclaim (俺たちの物語だ!! V40:p181) and adult challenge (自分を高く見積もんねーと V42:p161). The model gives register rules: address terms chosen by relationship and chronology, no catchphrase scattering, apology permits direct explanation, grief permits broken speech, and claims of an invariant sentence ending or profanity frequency are unsupported. BK-V01 found speech/register supported, though exact wording was not predicted. Not A: the vocabulary ledger calls its strings retrieval aids that must be rechecked on the page, there is no full address inventory, and ordinary conversation is sparse. Not C: many located strings, with register contrasts tied to partner and state.

Located ordinary or noncombat acts recur: repaying Kirishima's ¥49,800 goggles (V11:p176-177), supplying Kaminari a support option (V12:p156), the child-facing remedial course (V18:p113-166), drum recruitment and rehearsal with an objection to the project's appeasement framing (BK09, V19:p073-087, V20:p077-096), dorm and bath rivalry (V33:p157-160), class-funded armor (V42:p140-141) and adult peer banter and recruitment standards (V42:p156-161), with supplemental terse parental emails and profile preferences (BK-SUP-02, SUP-UA-024-01). The model analyzes BK09 as a discriminative policy (participation is not assent to the initial framing) and offers a festival-preparation reconstruction at medium confidence. Not B: the model says ordinary domestic life remains sparsely evidenced, the profile preferences are not behavioral scripts, and the festival reconstruction is medium confidence for an unfamiliar activity. Not D: there is an analyzed noncombat cooperation policy with repeated independent occasions, not merely scattered acts.

The model's partner table and the relationship ledger give directional, dated states for Midoriya (V01 hierarchy, V07:p185 defeat preferred to reliance, V13-V14 guilt and secret, V29 accountability, V33 apology, V36:p189 catching up, V40:p192 handoff, V42 missed invitation), Kirishima (equality-compatible help, V11:p024-025, p176-177), All Might (value anchor, V10:p104, p140, V14:p041-042, V36:p191-197 autograph, V40 rescue), Best Jeanist (withheld name, V25:p111-112, V30:p144-146), Shigaraki (hostile recognition without affinity, V10:p114-115), Aizawa (V10:p110), Uraraka (V05:p007-031), Todoroki (V05:p139-165), Jiro, Sero and Sato (V22:p095-111) and Edgeshot (V40). Not A: family relations rest on one V11 scene and supplemental emails, adult relationships outside the established friendships are OPEN, and validation is a single probe. Not C: the conditioning is explicit, discriminative and repeated across partners and periods.

Interiority rests on located self-disclosures and internal speech: the V13:p180-182 guilt confession with no one to discuss the secret, V29:p156 linking his bullying to his own weakness, the V33:p070-073 apology naming insecurity, the V36:p181-197 internal comparison and remembered autograph wish, the V42:p033-035 tears at Midoriya's loss, and the V40 statement that he could not have won alone. The model separates affective regimes (classroom impatience, combat intensity, private confession, public apology, hospital grief, adult banter) and warns that anger may mask fear or guilt but not always. Not A: BK-V01's emotional trajectory is partial, interior fear intensity is unmeasured, and he rejects All Might's fear description (V10:p140), so some affect is denied rather than disclosed. Not C: several independent self-disclosed inner states are located across periods.

Conflict regimes are located and differentiated: status-triggered escalation (V01, V02:p032-057), demanding full-power opposition (V05:p154-157), All Might exam impasse and first cooperation (V07:p160-190, V08:p047-068), captivity and refusal (V10:p102-114, probe-confirmed), private duel (V13:p158-182, V14:p033-039), team command with reciprocal rescue (V22:p095-111), battlefield planning and pre-deliberative interception (V29:p169-180), distributed maximum attack and status taunt (V36:p121-167), pain-mapped Cluster timing (V40:p121-183). The model distinguishes competitive insult, coercive humiliation, battlefield command and accountable apology by target, purpose and period. Not A: the only frozen prediction is BK-V01, and combat outcomes in V36-V40 depended on others' intervention. Not C: conflict policy is explicit, repeated and state-conditioned.

Located value positions: refusal of villain affiliation and even of false compliance on a stated value (V10:p104-105, p113; BK-V01 supported action and motive), a victory standard in which nobody is harmed (V26:p011-012), stated reasons for accompanying Midoriya (competence, rivalry, Kamino debt, complete victory; V28:p135-149), self-accountability for bullying (V29:p156) and the apology without a forgiveness demand (V33:p070-073). Not B: these are mostly value assertions or stated reasons rather than weighed dilemmas; the V29 interception is explicitly pre-deliberative (身体が勝手に動いてた), the V14 burden reframing comes from All Might's correction rather than his own deliberation, and civic or legal dilemmas are absent. Not D: the reasons are explicit, consistent and in one case validated by the probe.

Located but local: adult banter in which he needles teacher Midoriya and receives a joke back (BK-SUP-03, SUP-UAG-322-01), the V42:p156-161 recruitment banter, the gag-class supplemental item on classmates' demands for better speech (SUP-UAN-062-01) and V33 bath rivalry. No item analyzes a play or humor policy, and the model warns that banter does not establish uniform politeness. Not D: there is no repeated analyzed comic regime. Not NOT_ASSESSED: the domain is affirmatively located, though only locally.

The set spans V01-V42 through dense class-ledger deltas, directional relationship states, lexical anchors with locators, and a dedicated model of eight atoms with four discriminative supports (BK04a-c, BK09), three supplemental sections labeled by source class, two conditional reconstructions and one probe. Not B: ten volumes lack a class-ledger entry, the model corrects its own grouped BK04 locator (V13:p094-109 does not locate the guilt disclosure; V13:p180-182 does), the readiness index flags V28 and V36 Bakugo snapshot rows as malformed historical intrusions that are not valid freezes, the ledger strings are retrieval aids, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection. Not D: coverage is continuous across every major arc featuring him, and the model records its corrections rather than leaving them hidden.

Independent located limits: abrasive speech is not villain alignment (V10:p102-115, model REJECT); cooperation is not softening (V08:p059-062, V25:p086-098, V33:p157-160, V34:p163-168); his Kamino self-accusation is not the causal verdict (V13:p180 against All Might's V14:p041-042 correction); survival depended on Edgeshot (V36:p195, V37:p005-047, V40:p084-120); cardiac and arm restrictions persist (V42:p027-028); communication friction persists (V13:p035-036 civilian interface, V42:p156-161 missed invitation, p171-175 Iida's objection); participation is not assent (V19:p074-076); bullying is not excused by later heroism (V29:p156, V33:p070-073). Not A: several limits are model inferences drawn on a nonblind corpus, and limits outside school and war are thin. Not C: more than six independent limits are located with page and state. This is the grade most worth testing for overgrading.

Knowledge and state gates are explicit: OFA unknown before his V13:p157-161 inference and authorized only at V14:p048; Kamino guilt is concealed until V13:p180-182 and corrected at V14:p041-042; the apology belongs to V33 and must not be predicted from the V11 rescue; in V36 he cannot know Edgeshot will save him, and survival is OPEN through V37; the hero name is withheld until V30:p144-146; V42 medical constraints rule out both a reset and permanent incapacity. The model requires specifying OFA knowledge, Kamino, whether the apology has occurred, current injuries and helper trust before any response, and the class ledger forbids backfilling V05 into V04. Not A: the adult interval is undated and ten volumes lack entries. Not C: the gates are located and enforced.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates many real formulations across registers and gives explicit register rules, and BK-V01 found speech/register supported. But the vocabulary ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the Japanese page, the model says exact address terms must be chosen by relationship and chronology and that invariant-ending and profanity-frequency claims are unsupported, BK-V01 did not predict wording, and the model says generated dialogue would be illustrative prediction, never attributed quotation. Retrieving located lines is supported; writing new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Bakugo's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot, stated explicitly, with OFA knowledge, the Kamino guilt and its correction, the apology and current injuries fixed for it; later plural-victory language, gratitude and adult limits are never moved earlier.

The interlocutor is named and handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot, with the helper's demonstrated competence and equality stated; Midoriya-specific status sensitivity is not generalized to every partner.
The setting is one of the located regimes, with his physical state and available support stated.

Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels, keeps communication friction and status-triggered narrowing as live risks, produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named snapshot, stated explicitly: early U.A. (V01-V05), training and Kamino (V07-V14), cooperative student (V18-V29), apology and final war (V30-V41), or V42 recovery and adulthood; whether he has inferred or been told the OFA secret, whether Kamino and All Might's correction have happened, whether the V33 apology has occurred, and his current injuries and cardiac restrictions are fixed for that snapshot.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Midoriya, Kirishima, All Might, Best Jeanist, Aizawa, Edgeshot, Class 1-A peers, a villain recruiter, a child or the public, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; the helper's demonstrated competence and whether the relation preserves equality are stated, and Midoriya-linked status sensitivity is treated as relationship-specific.
setting_constraints: School training or competition, captivity or recruitment pressure, licensing or remedial work, internship or team rescue, war, a noncombat school project, or adult professional work
Physical state stated: early recoil limits, later technique, V36 cardiac injury and V40 return, or V42 arm and cardiac restrictions
No intimate adult disclosure, romance, domestic routine or family scene invented, and no apology or reconciliation assumed before it is located

scenario_readiness.note: Two conditional reconstructions are modeled: adult Bakugo offered help by a trusted teammate after overextending (high for operational cooperation, medium for the exact emotional response) and festival preparation (medium). The probe supports one captivity decision. Transfer to a materially novel context is supported only for policies the model states with their triggers: verify helper competence, accept a route that preserves agency, resist a route framed as pity, protect before calculating under mortal danger. Not READY: a single nonblind probe, two modeled reconstructions, and sparse domestic and adult private evidence. Not NOT_READY: the policies are explicit, repeated and gated by state.

conditions: Setting is a Class 1-A peer exchange, a school project or festival, a child-facing exercise, a dorm scene or an adult peer gathering in a named snapshot.
Abrasive delivery is not read as refusal or as hidden gentleness; participation is not read as assent to a project's initial framing.
No domestic routine, family scene, leisure biography or private adult relationship is invented, and supplemental profile facts constrain without becoming enacted scenes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located ordinary peer interaction exists (V11:p176-177, V12:p156, V18:p113-166, V19:p073-087, V20:p077-096, V33:p157-160, V42:p156-175) and BK09 states a discriminative policy for it. Not READY: domestic life is sparse by the model's own statement and the festival reconstruction is medium confidence. Not NOT_READY: peer ordinary interaction is repeated and analyzed.

conditions: The dilemma concerns pressure on his heroic self-definition, protection of an ally against his own standing or safety, or accountability for his own past conduct, in a named snapshot (after V29 for accountability, after V33 for the apology).
Value commitments are modeled as constraints, not as weighed deliberation he has not shown; a pre-deliberative protective move stays pre-deliberative.
Civic, legal or abstract dilemmas, and forgiveness on Midoriya's behalf, are not extrapolated beyond located positions.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported narrowly: the V10 refusal (probe-confirmed), the V26 no-casualty standard, the V28 stated reasons, V29 self-accountability and the V33 apology. Not READY: deliberation is mostly asserted value, not weighing, and civic dilemmas are absent. Not NOT_READY: the located value constraints are explicit and stable.

No curated item analyzes romantic interest or behavior; the model says adult romance remains sparsely evidenced and lists adult emotional disclosure outside the established friendships as OPEN. Nothing affirmatively bounds the domain, so this silence is neither evidence of a trait nor of an inability.

conditions: Setting is training, licensing, remedial work, internship, team rescue, war or adult hero work in a named snapshot, with his physical state (including V42 cardiac and arm restrictions) and available support stated.
Accepting or assigning help is not treated as weakness, and abrasive command is not treated as humiliation of a teammate or as incompetence.

Outcomes that depended on others (Edgeshot's repair, Midoriya's launch, the floating-U.A. infrastructure) are not reassigned to his solitary authorship, and public-facing communication friction is preserved.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional regimes: HUC triage with poor civilian communication (V13:p035-036), license failure and remediation (V13, V18), Jeanist placement and naming (V06, V25, V30), Match 4 reciprocal rescue (V22), licensed incident (V23), Endeavor internship and Natsuo rescue (V26), war planning (V29, V36, V40), adult work and recruitment standards (V42). The adult help reconstruction is modeled. Not READY: one nonblind probe and adult evidence is a narrow endpoint sample. Not NOT_READY: located and repeated.

known_limits.statement: Aggressive diction and resentment never make him recruitable: he refuses affiliation and even false compliance on his All Might value (V10:p102-105, p113), Shigaraki's inference that he could understand Bakugo fails (V10:p114-115), and Aizawa reads the conduct as surface over a genuine top-hero aim (V10:p110). The model REJECTs 'abusive speech makes him recruitable'.

Cooperation, rescue and accountability do not soften his register: cooperative action arrives before respectful language (V08:p059-062), interview abrasiveness persists after rescue growth (V25:p086-098), post-apology bath and dorm behavior stays competitive (V33:p157-160, V34:p163-168), and the vocabulary ledger says plural-dependence language stays abrasive. A softened Bakugo contradicts the located record.

His belief that his capture ended All Might (V13:p180-182) is self-accusation, not the causal verdict: All Might rejects sole causation and apologizes for missing the burden (V14:p041-042). The guilt must not be placed in the earlier V11 hand-taking.

His survival and return depended on others: catastrophic cardiac injury (V36:p195), Edgeshot's active repair at personal cost (V37:p005-047), Midoriya's launch and Edgeshot's 繋いだだけ framing (V40:p084-120), and his own 俺一人で…勝てるワケねーーンだよ. Do not reassign these outcomes to his solitary authorship.

After V42 he chooses difficult arm rehabilitation while doctors keep serious cardiac and rest restrictions (V42:p027-028); the model forbids assuming either permanent incapacity or a complete medical reset.

Accurate judgment coexists with a deficient communication interface: HUC fails his civilian-facing communication despite correct triage (V13:p035-036), Midoriya misses his indirect invitation (V42:p156-161) and Iida objects to competitive rescue timing (V42:p171-175). The model PRESERVEs continuing communication problems.

Joining a project is not assent to its framing: he objects to the band's conciliatory stress-relief meaning before reframing it as a serious challenge (V19:p074-076), and the model says BK09 does not establish willingness to join every hobby.

Later heroism does not excuse earlier bullying: he links it to his own weakness (V29:p156), apologizes and bows without demanding forgiveness (V33:p070-073), and the model says BK03's refusal does not make the bullying harmless.
The class-ledger carries no Bakugo entry for V15-V17, V21, V24, V27, V35, V38-V39 or V41; behavior there is unassessed by this set.
His family relations rest on one V11 Mitsuki scene and supplemental terse parental emails; no family-facing policy is modeled.
Ordinary domestic life, adult romance and emotional disclosure outside the established friendships are sparsely evidenced or OPEN in the model; the books do not supply every adult private response.

The one formal probe (BK-V01, V09 -> V10 recruitment) is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout on a single captivity decision, with emotional trajectory partial and wording unpredicted; no frozen prediction tests peer, professional, war or adult behavior.
